offering_description.value: Provides on-demand custom manufacturing of prototype and low-volume production parts for product developers and engineers. Uses injection molding, CNC machining, 3D printing and sheet metal fabrication, with online instant quoting. Also operates a network of third-party manufacturers for additional capacity and processes.

primary_products.value: custom CNC-machined parts; injection-molded parts; 3D-printed parts; custom sheet metal parts; urethane cast parts

primary_services.value: on-demand manufacturing; online instant quoting; design analysis feedback; sourcing through a manufacturing network

customer_segment.value: B2B: product developers, engineers and procurement teams at companies of all sizes

end_markets.value: medical and life sciences; aerospace and defense; automotive; consumer products; electronics and industrial equipment

revenue_model.value: project or contract: custom parts made to order per customer design, quoted and priced per order; product sales: manufactured parts sold in prototype and low-volume production quantities

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: buys raw metals and resins, makes custom parts in own factories, sells to engineering and product companies; service provider: network sourcing of parts from third-party manufacturers for customers

geography_served.value: global: Factories in the US, Europe and Japan, customers in North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: injection molding, CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal and network sourcing of custom parts

distribution_channels.value: online: web-based instant quote and ordering platform; direct sales: sales and application engineers supporting larger accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Quality certifications such as ISO 9001, AS9100 and ISO 13485, plus export control rules (ITAR) and environmental and workplace safety rules
